## Triage: first grade, `priority:p1` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T18:53Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1:** it writes wrong data: an inline edit of a `datetime` field saves local midnight and silently drops the time the record held (`packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx` ~`:548`–`:580`). A silent data change on save is p1.
- **For the claimant:** The filer's `domain:ui` and `area:records` stand. It is the last inline editor on the native date input, the same family as objectui#12664 (PR #12756). Land with or after that PR.

Claim: PM loop round 5 (`priority:p1`; triage grade `6222537339`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12759-inline-datetime`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12759` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the record page's inline `datetime` editor.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx`: the `date` / `datetime` arm (`:549`–`:580`), so a `datetime` edits date and time through the platform picker the grid, forms, dialogs and kanban already draw (objectui#12622, #12642, #12664 via PR #12756), never re-emitting local midnight;
- `@object-ui/fields` only to reuse an existing datetime-capable picker export; ⛔ no second picker;
- tests beside them;
- one `.changeset/12759-*.md` per touched released package.

Outside the surface: the `date` arm's `YYYY-MM-DD` write (objectui#12206) and the impossible-stored-day notice (objectui#10625 / #10567), which both stay; grid cells and forms (already on the picker); and any spec change.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: an internal editor stops dropping the stored time on save. No key, export or accept set changes. If the PR adds a prop or an export to `@object-ui/fields`, the body flips this line to `Clause-②: yes`, which the seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` ACCEPT covers.
Responsibility: objectui#12206 left the `datetime` arm on the date-only control (the source comment says so); objectui#12664's PR #12756 moved the other editors to the platform picker and named this one as the last
Thread-read: 6222537339
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `360e27a14d`. objectui#12664's PR #12756 (the triage's "land with or after") has merged. No open PR names `InlineFieldInput.tsx` or a date field in `@object-ui/fields` (every open PR's file list was read).

- **Open question 1 (files outside the surface): A.** The zone-driver `PINS` line is what makes the new UTC+8 / UTC−5 cases run at all. The three pending changesets each said the detail inline editor keeps the native input, which this change makes false, so the correction is owed (`check:changeset-claims`' WENT FALSE class). The `DatePickerField.tsx` change is a comment only. All three stay in the defect's class.
- **Open question 2: A, `Clause-②: no`.** The seat checked `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.ts` at the branch: it exports nothing from `InlineFieldInput.tsx`, and no non-test file outside it reads `INLINE_ROUTED_FIELD_TYPES`. No prop, package export or key changes.
- **The seat read the diff** at `6fdbc5d`: the `date` / `datetime` exclusion and the `DateField` branch are removed from `InlineFieldInput`, so both take the existing `FieldEditWidget` tail (the lazy picker). The `date` arm still writes `YYYY-MM-DD`. 13 files, +327/−92.
- **The two findings** are recorded, not filed (both say so).
- **NOT MEASURED** (the whole-package `plugin-detail` run hit the time cap) is accepted with the targeted sets; CI's 16 shards are the reading.
- **The seat's edit:** the dev's footer line in the PR body is replaced with the provenance line. Next: CI on `6fdbc5d`, then the ACCEPT.
